# Open-source VHS, analog horror, pixel art and lyric video templates

**A brand, site or song becomes a VHS screensaver, analog-horror trailer, pixel-art runner, lyric video or launch trailer.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_cab816145ddf.webp" alt="Motion formats play in turn: a pixel-art runner on a CRT night level, a wave rippling through a wordmark, a VHS bouncing logo and a kinetic lyric word." width="480"></p>

Seven complete motion formats, each with a beat structure in seconds, a shot list and presets: a found-footage analog-horror trailer of a website, an authentic VHS bouncing-logo screensaver, a pixel-art runner on a CRT, a wordmark with a wave running through it, a one-shot music video that follows a DAW timeline, a launch trailer for an import feature, and a kinetic lyric video. Values come from VHS signal models (ntsc-rs, Finn McKenty), pixel-art conventions (Pedro Medeiros, Slynyrd), School of Motion, Netflix timing rules, screenlife rules and launch-film designers on X. Use when someone asks for one of these formats, a VHS or analog-horror look, a pixel art animation, a lyric video or a beat-synced launch video. NOT for generating the song or footage (varg-ai, varg-music-video).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill motion-formats                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills motion-formats --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 25-second analog-horror trailer that browses my website and ends on the title"
- "VHS bouncing-logo screensaver with ./logo.svg that hits the corner on cue, 9:16"
- "Kinetic lyric video for ./song.mp3 from the lyrics in ./lyrics.txt"
